description:
Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev® é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício.


Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global.


Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.


Analista de Processos de Negócio na BairesDev


Como Analista de Processos de Negócio na BairesDev, você estabelecerá a conexão entre as necessidades de negócios e soluções técnicas. Você coletará e analisará requisitos, documentará processos de negócios e colaborará com equipes multifuncionais para implementar sistemas que melhorem a eficiência operacional. Seu papel será crucial para garantir que as soluções tecnológicas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de negócios e entreguem valor mensurável.


O que você fará:


- Analisar processos e fluxos de trabalho de negócios para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e otimização.

- Coletar, documentar e traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações funcionais para equipes de desenvolvimento.

- Colaborar com stakeholders para entender suas necessidades e garantir que as soluções atendam aos objetivos de negócios.

- Criar documentação detalhada, incluindo mapas de processos, casos de uso e histórias de usuário.

- Apoiar a testagem e implementação de novos sistemas e melhorias em soluções existentes.

- Atuar como intermediário entre usuários de negócios e equipes técnicas durante todo o ciclo de vida do projeto.



O que estamos procurando:


- 3+ anos de experiência em análise de negócios ou campo relacionado.

- Experiência com técnicas de coleta e documentação de requisitos.

- Conhecimento de modelagem e mapeamento de processos de negócios.

- Familiaridade com metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Waterfall).

- Capacidade de entender e documentar processos de negócios complexos.

- Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico.

- Inglês avançado.



Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil:


- Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.

- Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.

- Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

- Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.

- Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.

- Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.

- Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.

- Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.


Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar!

title: Analista de RH Pleno | People Operations
description:
Somos uma gestora especializada em investimentos alternativos na América Latina. Atualmente temos 6 fundos ativos, com investimentos primários, co-investimentos e secundários, somando um total de R$ 7 bilhões sob gestão.


Buscamos um(a) Analista de RH - People Operations para apoiar a execução das rotinas da área, garantindo organização, eficiência e conformidade nos processos de administração de pessoal, folha, benefícios e ciclo de vida do colaborador .


Como é o dia a dia?

Competências comportamentais da posição: pensamento crítico; protagonismo; atenção aos detalhes; facilidade para trabalhar com prazos; comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal. Serão diferenciais alunos que desempenhem suas atividades com autonomia e iniciativa.

Aqui, nós contratamos pessoas com capacidade e vontade de transformar, independente de qual seja a sua localização, idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou formação. Seu perfil e valores casam com os nossos? Então venha fazer parte!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with both technical systems and non-technical users .
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and clear way.
  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.

description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
  • Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Participa de iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

title: CLOSER
description:
MORADA


A MORADA atua no desenvolvimento de soluções e projetos estratégicos para empresas que desejam crescer com mais organização, eficiência e inteligência de negócios.


Nosso foco é ajudar empresas a estruturarem processos, aumentarem resultados e tomarem decisões mais estratégicas através de soluções consultivas. Trabalhamos com uma abordagem prática, direta e orientada à performance.


Valorizamos pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento, responsabilidade e foco em resultados. Buscamos profissionais que queiram construir algo grande e crescer junto com a empresa.

O Desafio


Expandir a operação comercial da MORADA e gerar novas oportunidades de negócio.

A posição exige alguém com perfil hunter , capaz de conduzir o processo completo de vendas: da prospecção ao fechamento.

Principais objetivos:

  • Prospectar novas empresas e gerar oportunidades comerciais
  • Qualificar leads e identificar dores do cliente
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais e apresentar soluções
  • Converter oportunidades em contratos
  • Atingir metas comerciais e expandir a carteira de clientes
  • Construir relacionamento com decisores e gestores
Principais Responsabilidades
  • Realizar contato ativo com leads (WhatsApp, telefone e networking)
  • Qualificar empresas com potencial de contratação
  • Diagnosticar necessidades e desafios do cliente
  • Conduzir reuniões de apresentação da solução
  • Elaborar e negociar propostas comerciais
  • Realizar follow-up com leads e oportunidades
  • Gerenciar pipeline de vendas e registrar atividades no CRM
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas até o fechamento
Requisitos
  • Experiência prévia com vendas consultivas ou vendas B2B
  • Perfil hunter , com facilidade para prospecção ativa e geração de oportunidades
  • Experiência em negociação e fechamento de vendas
  • Organização para gestão de pipeline e funil comercial
  • Experiência com CRM e acompanhamento de indicadores comerciais
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Capacidade de construir relacionamento com decisores
  • Disciplina e foco em metas e resultados
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente e orientado a performance


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com vendas de serviços consultivos
  • Vivência em ambientes de crescimento ou startups
  • Histórico comprovado de metas batidas em vendas
Meta Comercial

Gerar R$ 72.000 em vendas.

Remuneração

Período de validação 1º mês


Comissão sobre vendas geradas:

  • 50% se bater a meta
  • 5% se não bater
  • 60% se ultrapassar a meta

Esse período serve para validar disciplina, execução e adaptação ao processo comercial.


Após validação

  • R$ 4.000 fixo
  • Comissão entre 5% e 15% , aumentando conforme metas de faturamento forem atingidas.

Quanto maior o volume de vendas, maior a comissão.

Informações Gerais

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: PJ

Como se candidatar


Envie sua candidatura com:

  • Nome
  • Experiência em vendas
  • Maior resultado comercial já alcançado


Se o perfil fizer sentido, entraremos em contato para as próximas etapas do processo seletivo.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior (PHP E VUE)
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack PHP/Vue Sr , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.

PJ

100% home office


Sobre a Posição:

Buscamos um desenvolvedor Full Stack experiente e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de tecnologia, focado na manutenção e evolução de sistema legado de alta demanda. O profissional ideal deve ter uma mentalidade orientada a soluções e disposição para trabalhar tanto com tecnologias frontend modernas e legadas quanto com diferentes versões do PHP em um ambiente tecnológico heterogêneo.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Backend

Sólida experiência com PHP, incluindo domínio das versões 5.6 e 7.0;

Proficiência em MySQL 5.6, incluindo otimização de queries e performance;

Experiência com Docker e containerização;

Domínio de Git e boas práticas de controle de versão;

Experiência com sistemas de cache, especialmente Redis;

Conhecimento desejável em Google Cloud Platform .


- Frontend

Experiência sólida com Vue.js e seus ecossistemas;

Domínio de JavaScript;

Experiência com jQuery em sistemas legados;

Conhecimento de HTML5 e CSS3;

Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.


Principais atividades:

- Manter e aprimorar sistema legado de alto tráfego;

- Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando Vue.js;

- Realizar a manutenção de códigos legados em jQuery;

- Implementar melhorias de performance e segurança;

- Realizar refatorações estratégicas mantendo a estabilidade do sistema;

- Colaborar na modernização gradual do código frontend e backend;

- Participar ativamente do planejamento técnico;

- Documentar alterações e processos técnicos;

- Mentor técnico para desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia com sistemas de alta demanda;

- Conhecimentos em práticas de CI/CD;

- Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis;

- Experiência em modernização gradual de sistemas legados;

- Conhecimento em arquitetura de software;

- Experiência com testes automatizados (PHPUnit, Jest);

- Conhecimentos em UI/UX e design responsivo.

O candidato ideal deve ser capaz de equilibrar a manutenção de código legado com a implementação gradual de melhorias, tanto no frontend quanto no backend, mantendo sempre a estabilidade do sistema em produção. Valorizamos profissionais que vejam sistemas legados como oportunidades de aprendizado e evolução tecnológica.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Programa Jovem Aprendiz 2026
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.

Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.


Buscamos um(a) profissional que atuará: Jovem Aprendiz (Administrativo/Produção):

  • Auxiliar nas rotinas dos Departamentos;
  • Realizar atendimento, acompanhamento de relatórios, input de dados em sistema;
  • Atender outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao programa.


Quais são os requisitos imprescindíveis para essa vaga?

  • Ensino médio cursando ou completo
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office
  • Ter entre 18 e 22 anos


Nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Refeitório no local (para os dias presenciais no Complexo Butantan);
  • Vale Refeição (para os dias de treinamento externo);
  • Ônibus fretado - Instituto Butantan/ Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Descontos em parcerias de entretenimentos;
  • Ingressos para os museus do Butantan;
  • Totalpass – benefício focado na saúde e bem estar dos colaboradores;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e auto avaliação;
  • Participação em palestras e Workshops realizados no Butantan;
  • Mentoria;
  • Day Off de aniversário – O (a) Aprendiz terá direito a uma folga no mês do aniversário, acordado com a gestão.


Informações complementares:

Período de inscrições: 16/03/2026 a 30/03/2026

Quantidade de vaga(s): 60

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil

Horário de trabalho: 08h às 14h15 ou 12h às 18h15

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;
  • Entrevista com recrutadores;
  • Entrevista individual com o requisitante;
  • Entrevista individual com o gestor do requisitante.


Todas as etapas são eliminatórias e podemos indicar uma ou mais etapas a informar no processo seletivo.


*Validade do processo seletivo: 06 meses

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Company Description

Scandinavian Capital Markets is a foreign currency broker based in Stockholm with a remote workforce. We are building the next generation of currency trading technology and products, and we are looking for someone who can work independently and think outside the box. If you are someone who excels at mobile technologies, but also wants to have a voice in high-level decisions such as architecture and product, we want to meet you!


Role Description

We are looking for a sharp, independent engineer to join our team as a Fullstack Mobile Developer. You will work directly with our core team to build, optimize, and scale the mobile applications driving our product. This is a fully remote position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Design and build robust backend APIs (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript, or Python) to support real-time mobile features.
  • Implement secure, seamless user interfaces (UI/UX) for complex financial dashboards and trading screens.
  • Handle real-time market data streams by integrating WebSockets and optimizing app state management.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript. (must)
  • Solid backend experience (Node.js, Python, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience with financial markets, fintech apps, or secure payment gateways.

title: Closer Outbound
description:
Closer – Marketing Agency

Fluent English | 100% Remote | Contractor (PJ)


At Stealth Manager , you will play a key role in driving new business by proactively connecting with international prospects and turning opportunities into long-term partnerships.


What You Will Do:

  • Conduct outbound outreach to potential clients and schedule demo calls in English;
  • Lead sales calls and present digital marketing solutions tailored to client needs;
  • Manage the sales pipeline from prospecting to closing;
  • Build relationships with international prospects and identify new business opportunities;


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience in sales (preferably in digital marketing/advertising);
  • Fluent English (mandatory);
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and client acquisition;
  • Knowledge of marketing services such as SEO, PPC, and social media;
  • Familiarity with CRM software and Google Workspace (G Suite);
  • Strong communication, organization, and results-driven mindset.


What We Offer:

  • Contractor contract (PJ) | 100% remote;
  • Performance bonuses;
  • Paid vacation + holidays;
  • Maternity/paternity leave;
  • Partnership with Open English;
  • Professional development program.


Join Us!

Stealth Manager is a leading digital marketing agency, recognized for its creative and effective white-label solutions for the U.S. market. But what is white-label marketing? It’s a model in which we provide specialized marketing services for partner agencies, allowing them to resell our work as their own—ensuring excellence in delivery and strengthening their brands.

In 2024, we achieved an impressive 300% growth , reinforcing our commitment to outstanding results and successful partnerships. We operate across more than 70 niches , fostering a collaborative, dynamic, and team-oriented environment focused on performance.

At Stealth, we deeply value people. We believe a happy and motivated team is the key to high-performance results. Our culture is guided by the motto “Work Smart and Be Nice” —combining smart work with kindness, creating an environment where freedom and responsibility go hand in hand to drive both professional and personal growth.

Join our team and help transform challenges into success stories!

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Eletricista Subtransmissão Linha Viva II
description:
Sinta a nossa energia!


Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro, Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!




Sua energia será muito importante para:

Responsável por executar as manutenções e operações das linhas de transmissão e subestações do sistema elétrico da Coelba, segundo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos, garantindo a qualidade, confiabilidade, segurança e a continuidade do fornecimento de energia elétrica em todo o estado da Bahia.



Atividades:

  • Trabalhar em conformidade com procedimentos e manual de conduta;
  • Executar tarefas de suporte administrativo/de escritório em um ambiente de escritório, campo ou local;
  • Execução das inspeções visuais, termográficas, manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas nos ativos de subtransmissão;
  • Garantir a qualidade das intervenções por meio da execução de serviços de manuseio, transporte de carga/descarga de equipamentos e materiais de uso na manutenção;
  • Assegurar melhorias de qualidade em subestações e linhas por meio do auxílio na execução de obras CAPEX e OPEX nessas instalações;
  • Reduzir tempo e número de interrupções fortuitas através de serviços de apoio a outras áreas, associados a operação e manutenção em linhas de subtransmissão e distribuição;
  • Acompanhamento diário dos registros de eventos de relés digitais e identificação e correção de falhas em ativos de subtransmissão;
  • Coordenar trabalhos de campo, dirigir viaturas, planejar atividades, interpretar projetos, relatórios e relatórios da ordem de serviço, realizar acompanhamento das obras em campo, orientar sobre risco de acidente, prestar suporte de socorro em caso de acidente, e ou problemas de saúde, realizar integração / DSS com sua equipe;
  • Elaborar planos operacionais, colaborando com sugestões, fazendo mudanças de funções , delegando atividades e supervisionando o trabalho das equipes;
  • Desenvolver a sua equipe de maneira a promover o crescimento profissional e intelectual de cada membro.

  • Pacote office - nível básico;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar na cidade de Feira de Santana/ BA .

Domínio de Git e boas práticas de controle de versão;

Experiência com sistemas de cache, especialmente Redis;

Conhecimento desejável em Google Cloud Platform .

Experiência sólida com Vue.js e seus ecossistemas;

Domínio de JavaScript;

Experiência com jQuery em sistemas legados;

Conhecimento de HTML5 e CSS3;

Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.


Principais atividades:

- Manter e aprimorar sistema legado de alto tráfego;

- Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando Vue.js;

- Realizar a manutenção de códigos legados em jQuery;

- Implementar melhorias de performance e segurança;

- Realizar refatorações estratégicas mantendo a estabilidade do sistema;

- Colaborar na modernização gradual do código frontend e backend;

- Participar ativamente do planejamento técnico;

- Documentar alterações e processos técnicos;

- Mentor técnico para desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia com sistemas de alta demanda;

- Conhecimentos em práticas de CI/CD;

- Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis;

- Experiência em modernização gradual de sistemas legados;

- Conhecimento em arquitetura de software;

- Experiência com testes automatizados (PHPUnit, Jest);

- Conhecimentos em UI/UX e design responsivo.

O candidato ideal deve ser capaz de equilibrar a manutenção de código legado com a implementação gradual de melhorias, tanto no frontend quanto no backend, mantendo sempre a estabilidade do sistema em produção. Valorizamos profissionais que vejam sistemas legados como oportunidades de aprendizado e evolução tecnológica.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Data Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Maintain and evolve Fraud Deflect’s data stack: reliable pipelines, strong data models, and stable production operations on Linux. Focus is improving what exists, not rewriting everything.


Responsibilities

  • Own data architecture and data modeling for core datasets.
  • Maintain and improve existing pipelines (stability, backfills, performance, data quality).
  • Build/operate Airflow workflows (SLAs, retries, alerting, idempotency).
  • Write and optimize SQL in MySQL (schemas, migrations, indexing, query tuning).
  • Develop pipeline/tooling code in Python.
  • Operate and debug on Linux (services/jobs, logs, incidents, automation).
  • Work within the current stack (Airflow, AWS, MySQL; ClickHouse is a plus).
  • Add basic observability; dashboards/visuals are a plus.
  • Communicate clearly; apply strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL.
  • Airflow in production.
  • AWS experience.
  • Python proficiency.
  • Comfortable maintaining systems on Linux.
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.


Nice to have

  • Observability/visualization (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior Clickhouse experience.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

description:

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Company: Deep.BI


About Deep.BI

﻿Deep.BI provides consulting, enterprise support, and engineering services for open-source data infrastructure and real-time analytics platforms .

  • Apache Druid
  • StarRocks

  • Apache Kafka

  • Kubernetes

What you'll work on

✔ Migrate from legacy or commercial systems to open-source stacks

✔ Operate high-availability distributed systems

✔ Build infrastructure supporting real-time analytics workloads

  • Deploy distributed data platforms including Kafka, Flink, Druid, StarRocks and Cassandra
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-native infrastructure

  • Configure autoscaling and resource optimization
  • Deploy systems across cloud, on-prem, hybrid, and BYOC environments
Platform Migrations
  • Execute commercial / enterprise → open-source migrations
  • Support legacy platform modernization
  • Implement zero-downtime migration

Platform Operations
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems
  • Support mission-critical analytics platforms
  • Improve automation, deployment workflows, and reliability

  • Strong experience operating Kubernetes clusters in production
  • Kubernetes networking (e.g., Calico, Cilium)
  • Experience deploying large-scale distributed systems
  • Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and CI/CD
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex distributed infrastructure issues
  • Infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Helm, etc.)
  • Observability and monitoring systems


Experience With Data Platforms (Strongly Preferred)

Experience with one or more of the following:

  • Apache Kafka
  • Apache Flink
  • Apache Druid
  • StarRocks
  • Apache Cassandra
  • Hadoop ecosystem


Additional Skills (Nice to Have)
  • Experience operating large-scale data infrastructure
  • Experience supporting production environments with high availability requirements


Why Join Deep.BI
  • Work on cutting-edge open-source data technologies
  • Solve complex problems in distributed systems and data infrastructure
  • Collaborate with experts in streaming, database and platform engineering
  • Work in a fully remote engineering culture
  • Help organizations modernize their data platforms and analytics infrastructure
Interested? 

If you enjoy building and operating distributed infrastructure and modern data platforms, we would love to hear from you.

title: Analista de RH Pleno | People Operations
description:
Somos uma gestora especializada em investimentos alternativos na América Latina. Nossos portfólios têm exposição a estratégias diversas, como VC, Growth, Buyout, Distress e nichos de mercado específicos onde haja alto potencial de retorno. Atualmente temos 6 fundos ativos, com investimentos primários, co-investimentos e secundários, somando um total de R$ 7 bilhões sob gestão.


Buscamos um(a) Analista de RH - People Operations para apoiar a execução das rotinas da área, garantindo organização, eficiência e conformidade nos processos de administração de pessoal, folha, benefícios e ciclo de vida do colaborador .


Como é o dia a dia?

• Executar e acompanhar rotinas de People Operations: folha de pagamento, admissões, desligamentos, férias, 13º salário, benefícios e segurança do trabalho;

• Analisar e validar cálculos e dados de folha, além de acompanhar indicadores de pessoas (turnover, movimentações e provisões);

• Atuar como ponto focal de benefícios, incluindo relacionamento com fornecedores e apoio em campanhas de saúde e bem-estar.

• Apoio no acompanhamento de indicadores de pessoas e orçamento da área

• Conduzir processos de onboarding e offboarding e apoiar iniciativas de RH, como treinamentos, pesquisas e eventos internos e offsites.

• Gestão e atualização de sistemas e bases de dados de RH e contribuir para melhorias de processos e automações.


O que buscamos?

• Graduação em Administração, Contabilidade, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência prévia em rotinas de People Operations / Administração de Pessoal , preferencialmente no mercado financeiro .

• Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista, folha de pagamento e benefícios .

• Excel avançado e bom domínio do pacote Office.

• Capacidade analítica para interpretação de dados, indicadores e relatórios de folha . Perfil analítico, organização e atenção a detalhes.


Competências comportamentais da posição: pensamento crítico; protagonismo; atenção aos detalhes; facilidade para trabalhar com prazos; comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal. Serão diferenciais alunos que desempenhem suas atividades com autonomia e iniciativa.


Se os seus conhecimentos forem aderentes à vaga, é tudo o que importa. Aqui, nós contratamos pessoas com capacidade e vontade de transformar, independente de qual seja a sua localização, idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou formação. Seu perfil e valores casam com os nossos? Então venha fazer parte!

title: Social Media & Content Strategist (Júnior)
description:
O que você fará?

Como Estrategista de Conteúdo e Growth , você atuará diretamente com a Head de Marketing na execução e estratégia de todos os produtos do portfólio. O foco é traduzir o valor técnico de cada marca em ativos de marketing de alta performance (visual e escrito) para o mercado nacional e internacional.


Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Apoiar na pesquisa de nichos e concorrentes para construir cronogramas de conteúdo alinhados aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Criar peças de design gráfico de alta qualidade para LinkedIn, Instagram e Blogs.
  • Editar vídeos curtos (Reels/TikTok/LinkedIn) com foco em alta retenção e clareza de mensagem.
  • Adaptar o tom de voz e a identidade visual para as marcas dentro do portfólio de produto, garantindo consistência e qualidade.
  • Manter-se à frente das tendências de IA, Design e SaaS para trazer ideias de conteúdo e experimentos de crescimento.
  • Gerenciar agendamentos de postagens, interação com a comunidade e acompanhamento de métricas.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês Fluente (escrita e leitura - essencial, pois o conteúdo é voltado para o mercado americano).
  • Domínio de Design: Proficiência em Figma ou Pacote Adobe (Photoshop/Illustrator).
  • Edição de Vídeo: Experiência com CapCut, Premiere ou ferramentas similares para vídeos curtos.
  • Mentalidade Estratégica: Capacidade de explicar o \"porquê\" por trás de uma postagem, não apenas o \"como\".
  • Portfólio com trabalhos anteriores de social media, design e/ou edição de vídeo.
  • Residir no Brasil.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com fluxos de trabalho assistidos por IA (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Submagick, etc.).
  • Formação ou interesse em Psicologia, Marketing ou Design.
  • Experiência prévia em Startups ou Estúdios de Produto.
  • Conhecimento de marketing B2B, B2C e redes sociais.


O que oferecemos?

  • Contratação PJ;
  • Plano de carreira e crescimento acelerado em um mercado global;
  • Horário semi flexível: 9h-13h (fixo) + 4h flexíveis;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto;
  • Encontro com o time anual 100% custeada pela Esfera;
  • Autonomia no trabalho e ambiente dinâmico;
  • Contrato inicial de experiência: 3 meses.

description:

Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace

  • Agile Development: Embrace agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate project delivery.



What we’re looking for:




  • Strong experience with JDBC, JDBI or ORM tools
  • Practical experience and a strong grasp of Java concurrency
  • Development of distributed systems
  • High level proficiency and skills in at least one of the following technologies: AMQP, ZeroMQ, JMS, Kafka
  • Strong experience with MVC frameworks
  • Knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Understanding of principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Proficiency in backend development, including Rest API practice
  • Proficiency in principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Expert in creating automated unit and integration tests
  • Proficiency of multi-thread applications, OOP & MVC concepts and design patterns
  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems.

We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

description:

Location: Remote (Preferred location: Rio de Janeiro), (telework), with the possibility of in-person work as required by the company.  

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

  • Case Management: Oversee all aspects of the Visa and Immigration Service to guarantee a smooth process. Ensure timely completion and accuracy of all visa and immigration documents. Regularly update and maintain client records with strict adherence to legal requirements.
  • Client Consultation: Provide tailored advice to clients on obtaining necessary documentation for international migration. Establish strong, individualized communication channels with clients.
  • Operational Excellence: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of immigration legislation and procedures. Build and sustain professional relationships with clients and colleagues.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Project Management Skills with exceptional organizational and time management skills, with a strong focus on detail. A detail-oriented person with strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to multitask and resolve complex issues in a dynamic environment. Maintain a prompt system for the timely filing of extensions, petitions, and applications. Coordinate filing of applications and petitions.
  • Proactive and effective communication with clients and team members. Evaluate and organize documents supporting applications and petitions. Function as a liaison between clients' petitions and attorneys.
  • Function as a liaison between clients' petitions and attorneys. Demonstrated compassion and integrity in client interactions. Commitment to maintaining high standards of ethical and professional conduct.


EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • Previous experience in the immigration field is highly desirable.
  • Fluency in English; native Portuguese speaker.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Atuar no suporte a incidentes envolvendo VTEX, Hub de Integração e ERP.
  • Realizar triagem e análise funcional/técnica inicial antes do escalonamento para Produto ou Desenvolvimento.
  • Abrir, acompanhar e encerrar tickets técnicos junto a fornecedores (VTEX, integrações, etc.), garantindo contexto, evidências e retorno aos solicitantes.
  • Analisar e interpretar logs, APIs e fluxos de integração, identificando falhas de processo, cadastro ou sistema.
  • Validar jornadas do usuário no front-end, identificando quebras, impactos no negócio e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Monitorar de forma proativa processos críticos do e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, impostos e cadastros).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de plataformas e parceiros.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação, evitando alinhamentos paralelos e respeitando os fluxos definidos.
  • Registrar recorrências e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais do e-commerce.
  • Apoiar a padronização de atendimentos, fluxos e documentação, contribuindo para a maturidade do suporte.


Experiência :

  • Conhecimento em VTEX (IO / FastStore).
  • Experiência com Hub de Integrações.
  • Capacidade de interpretação de logs e APIs REST (JSON, HTTP).
  • Noções de ITIL e processos de suporte.
  • Entendimento dos fluxos de e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, cadastros e cálculo de impostos).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados e acompanhamento de SLA.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas.


Valorizamos a diversidade e incentivamos a candidatura de profissionais de todos os perfis. Esta vaga é aberta a pessoas de diferentes gêneros, raças, orientações, idades, pessoas com deficiência e demais grupos.

title: ITSM Support Specialist

  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: Technical Support Specialist (L2)
description:
Warmy.io is an innovative email deliverability platform that helps businesses optimize their email outreach and achieve higher engagement rates. We work with global B2B SaaS companies, ensuring their email communications land in inboxes, not spam folders.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Technical Support Specialist  based in the to join our team and provide outstanding customer support for our platform users.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Support Specialist  to assist customers with troubleshooting, onboarding, and ongoing support related to email deliverability, integrations, and best practices. The ideal candidate has 2+ years of experience in technical support , preferably in a B2B SaaS  environment, and is comfortable handling support via both chat and calls.

This role requires excellent English communication skills (both written and spoken) , strong problem-solving abilities, and a customer-centric approach.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support via chat, email, and calls  to assist customers with issues related to email deliverability, integrations, and platform usage.

Requirements

✅ 2+ years of experience  in a Technical Support  role, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment .

✅ Ability to work with ticketing systems, live chat tools, and CRM platforms .

✅ Must be comfortable working with a camera on  for calls with customers and team members.

✅ Experience with B2B SaaS platforms  is a strong advantage.

Work Schedule

  • Full-time, remote .
  • Monday-Friday:  2 pm - 10 pm Ukrainian time, Sunday - half a day.
  • During the first month of training, work hours will be adjusted to align with the team for better learning and collaboration.

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote role  with a stable schedule .
  • Competitive salary  based on experience.
  • 12 PTO days, 10 sick days , and public holiday recognition.
  • Opportunity for professional growth  in a fast-growing SaaS company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $6,500 - $7,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Lead Software Engineer who will collaborate with and shepherd software engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers, and will develop AI-based software solutions to better address the needs of their constituents (students, alumni, faculty, researchers, staff, and the community at large). You will have the chance to guide and continuously improve the ways in which they engage, educate, and empower people around the world, combining the best of human touch and technology scale, exploring the use of everything from the latest generative AI models to blended and immersive environments, multi-modal and varied-form content, and the most innovative research and teaching methodologies.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, taking into account business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives.
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology.
  • Design solutions, build initial code, and provide documentation with ways of working to minimize time to value and maximize re-usability.
  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what they do and how they do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value.
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert.
  • Actively contribute to and re-use community best practices.
  • Embody the values and passions that characterize the institution, with empathy to engage with colleagues from a wide range of backgrounds.
  • Promote software engineering, data science, machine learning, AI, and digital and emerging technologies within the institution through relevant channels including community engagement, networking, speeches, and publications as applicable.
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

Required skills

  • 7+ years of work experience in Software Engineering  or a Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics.
  • 3–5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment .
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products .
  • Strong Python  and Typescript/JavaScript  skills required.
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling  (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning  (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required.
  • Experience with cloud  computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform.
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required.
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities.


Desired skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable.
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews.
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas.
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.
  • Proficiency with data visualization tools is desirable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build innovative AI solutions at a world-class academic institution.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


Work Schedule:  Overlap with US Eastern Standard Time.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

title: Product Designer
description:

We’re looking for a talented Product Designer. You’ll be a key player in a small and highly-collaborative team, working closely with product and engineering to shape the future of our product and company.

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: \"Analista de suporte Ecommerce Pleno #993094\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Atuar no suporte a incidentes envolvendo VTEX, Hub de Integração e ERP.
  • Realizar triagem e análise funcional/técnica inicial antes do escalonamento para Produto ou Desenvolvimento.
  • Abrir, acompanhar e encerrar tickets técnicos junto a fornecedores (VTEX, integrações, etc.), garantindo contexto, evidências e retorno aos solicitantes.
  • Analisar e interpretar logs, APIs e fluxos de integração, identificando falhas de processo, cadastro ou sistema.
  • Validar jornadas do usuário no front-end, identificando quebras, impactos no negócio e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Monitorar de forma proativa processos críticos do e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, impostos e cadastros).

description:

The ideal candidate has 2+ years of experience in technical support , preferably in a B2B SaaS  environment, and is comfortable handling support via both chat and calls.

Requirements

✅ 2+ years of experience  in a Technical Support  role, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment .

✅ Strong experience with email-related issues  (email deliverability, SMTP, email warm-up, domain authentication, etc.).

✅ Fluent in English (spoken and written)  – ability to explain complex technical issues clearly.

✅ Strong troubleshooting skills  and ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues effectively.

✅ Ability to work with ticketing systems, live chat tools, and CRM platforms .

✅ Must be comfortable working with a camera on  for calls with customers and team members.

✅ Experience with B2B SaaS platforms  is a strong advantage.

Work Schedule

  • Full-time, remote .
  • Monday-Friday:  2 pm - 10 pm Ukrainian time, Sunday - half a day.

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote role  with a stable schedule .
  • Competitive salary  based on experience.
  • 12 PTO days, 10 sick days , and public holiday recognition.
  • Opportunity for professional growth  in a fast-growing SaaS company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: AI Engineer
description:
