title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $6,500 - $7,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Lead Software Engineer who will collaborate with and shepherd software engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers, and will develop AI-based software solutions to better address the needs of their constituents (students, alumni, faculty, researchers, staff, and the community at large). You will have the chance to guide and continuously improve the ways in which they engage, educate, and empower people around the world, combining the best of human touch and technology scale, exploring the use of everything from the latest generative AI models to blended and immersive environments, multi-modal and varied-form content, and the most innovative research and teaching methodologies.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, taking into account business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives.
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology.
  • Design solutions, build initial code, and provide documentation with ways of working to minimize time to value and maximize re-usability.
  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what they do and how they do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value.
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert.
  • Actively contribute to and re-use community best practices.
  • Embody the values and passions that characterize the institution, with empathy to engage with colleagues from a wide range of backgrounds.
  • Promote software engineering, data science, machine learning, AI, and digital and emerging technologies within the institution through relevant channels including community engagement, networking, speeches, and publications as applicable.
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

Required skills

  • 7+ years of work experience in Software Engineering  or a Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics.
  • 3–5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment .
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products .
  • Strong Python  and Typescript/JavaScript  skills required.
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling  (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning  (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required.
  • Experience with cloud  computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform.
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required.
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities.


Desired skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable.
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews.
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas.
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.
  • Proficiency with data visualization tools is desirable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build innovative AI solutions at a world-class academic institution.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


Work Schedule:  Overlap with US Eastern Standard Time.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with both technical systems and non-technical users .
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and clear way.
  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.

title: Immigration Paralegal
description:
POSITION SPECIFICATION


Position Title: Immigration Paralegals

Reporting To: Operations Manager

Location: Remote (Preferred location: Rio de Janeiro), (telework), with the possibility of in-person work as required by the company.  

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US


HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.


POSITION SUMMARY

The Case Manager EB2-NIW plays a pivotal role in assisting Immigration Attorneys in preparing cases on behalf of our clients, individuals relocating internationally. This position requires a detail-oriented approach to ensure immigration documentation aligns seamlessly with necessary requirements, facilitating faster, more effective case management in compliance with legislation.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Case Management: Oversee all aspects of the Visa and Immigration Service to guarantee a smooth process. Ensure timely completion and accuracy of all visa and immigration documents. Regularly update and maintain client records with strict adherence to legal requirements.
  • Client Consultation: Provide tailored advice to clients on obtaining necessary documentation for international migration. Establish strong, individualized communication channels with clients.
  • Operational Excellence: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of immigration legislation and procedures. Build and sustain professional relationships with clients and colleagues.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Project Management Skills with exceptional organizational and time management skills, with a strong focus on detail. A detail-oriented person with strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to multitask and resolve complex issues in a dynamic environment. Maintain a prompt system for the timely filing of extensions, petitions, and applications. Coordinate filing of applications and petitions.
  • Proactive and effective communication with clients and team members. Evaluate and organize documents supporting applications and petitions. Function as a liaison between clients' petitions and attorneys.
  • Function as a liaison between clients' petitions and attorneys. Demonstrated compassion and integrity in client interactions. Commitment to maintaining high standards of ethical and professional conduct.


EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • Previous experience in the immigration field is highly desirable.
  • Fluency in English; native Portuguese speaker.
  • Paralegal Certificate is considered a plus.


APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume in PDF format to .

  • Contratação PJ;
  • Plano de carreira e crescimento acelerado em um mercado global;
  • Horário semi flexível: 9h-13h (fixo) + 4h flexíveis;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto;
  • Encontro com o time anual 100% custeada pela Esfera;
  • Autonomia no trabalho e ambiente dinâmico;
  • Contrato inicial de experiência: 3 meses.

title: Head de manutenção
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Head de manutenção para uma empresa localizada em Camaçari/BA .

Seu perfil corresponde ao da vaga descrita abaixo? Então, faça sua candidatura!


Objetivo da posição:

Coordenar a manutenção industrial, os projetos de CAPEX Sustaining, a confiabilidade, o planejamento e a gestão de custos, assegurando alta disponibilidade dos ativos, segurança operacional e uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, com forte controle de OPEX e CAPEX.


Principais responsabilidades:

Gestão de Equipe

  • Liderar equipes próprias e terceirizadas de: Mecânica; Elétrica; Instrumentação e Facilities
  • Desenvolver competências técnicas e comportamentais.
  • Garantir alocação eficiente de recursos e produtividade das equipes.
  • Assegurar práticas seguras, atendimento as normas e ambiente de trabalho adequado.
  • Promover o alinhamento e a comunicação assertiva com outros departamentos, garantindo que a Unidade de Negócio atinja seus objetivos globais de desempenho.


Gestão de Manutenção

  • Coordenar manutenções preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, garantindo confiabilidade e segurança dos ativos.
  • Assegurar resposta estruturada a falhas críticas e emergências.
  • Promover padronização técnica e disciplina operacional.
  • Realizar as rotinas de PCM (planejamento e programação);
  • Promover análises de falhas (RCA), FMEA e práticas de confiabilidade.
  • Reduzir falhas recorrentes, backlog e manutenções emergenciais.
  • Manter os indicadores de manutenção (KPIs) atualizados, assegurando o cumprimento das metas de desempenho e buscando a melhoria contínua dos processos.
  • Zelar pelo armazenamento técnico e organização de materiais no almoxarifado e pátios de equipamentos.


Gestão de Contratos e Facilities

  • Gerenciar contratos de manutenção industrial e facilities.
  • Controlar escopo, SLAs, custos, desempenho técnico e segurança dos prestadores.
  • Apoiar processos de contratação, renegociação e avaliação de fornecedores.
  • Buscar oportunidades de otimização de contratos e redução de custos totais.


Gestão de Custos (OPEX e CAPEX)

  • Gerir o orçamento anual de manutenção (OPEX) e de CAPEX Sustaining.
  • Elaborar previsões orçamentárias (budget e forecast).
  • Controlar custos de: Materiais e sobressalentes; Serviços e contratos
  • Analisar desvios entre planejado × realizado e definir planos de ação.
  • Implementar iniciativas de redução de custo sem aumento de risco operacional.
  • Garantir correta classificação contábil entre OPEX e CAPEX.
  • Projetos de Investimento – CAPEX Sustaining
  • Gerenciar o portfólio de CAPEX Sustaining.
  • Elaborar escopos técnicos, estimativas de investimento e cronogramas.
  • Acompanhar execução física e financeira dos projetos.
  • Garantir comissionamento, entrega técnica e incorporação correta dos ativos ao sistema de gestão.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida atuação em planejamento de manutenção industrial;
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos (CAPEX Sustaining);
  • Vivência em gestão de custos;
  • Domínio das ferramentas e metodologias de confiabilidade;
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (SAP PM);
  • Vivência em projetos de melhoria contínua e confiabilidade.


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Analytics Engineer - Sênior
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
  • Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Participa de iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Apoia e pareia com analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;


Diferencial

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelagens para IA em iniciativas de ML, copilots, agentes e observabilidade.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
  • Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

description:

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

description:
Senior Front End Engineer

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.

We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Technical Support Specialist (L2)
description:
Warmy.io is an innovative email deliverability platform that helps businesses optimize their email outreach and achieve higher engagement rates. We work with global B2B SaaS companies, ensuring their email communications land in inboxes, not spam folders.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Technical Support Specialist  based in the to join our team and provide outstanding customer support for our platform users.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Support Specialist  to assist customers with troubleshooting, onboarding, and ongoing support related to email deliverability, integrations, and best practices. The ideal candidate has 2+ years of experience in technical support , preferably in a B2B SaaS  environment, and is comfortable handling support via both chat and calls.

This role requires excellent English communication skills (both written and spoken) , strong problem-solving abilities, and a customer-centric approach.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support via chat, email, and calls  to assist customers with issues related to email deliverability, integrations, and platform usage.
  • Guide customers through troubleshooting processes  and provide step-by-step solutions.
  • Conduct screen-sharing sessions  when needed to resolve more complex technical issues.
  • Maintain a high standard of written and verbal communication  to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Work closely with internal teams (engineering, customer success, and product) to escalate and resolve customer issues efficiently.
  • Keep thorough documentation of support interactions and contribute to the internal knowledge base.
  • Assist in onboarding new customers , ensuring a smooth adoption of our platform.
  • Ensure that your camera is always on  during support calls and team meetings for a more personalized customer experience.

✅ 2+ years of experience  in a Technical Support  role, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment .

✅ Proficiency in handling support via calls  (previous experience with call-based support is a must).

✅ Strong experience with email-related issues  (email deliverability, SMTP, email warm-up, domain authentication, etc.).

✅ Fluent in English (spoken and written)  – ability to explain complex technical issues clearly.

✅ Strong troubleshooting skills  and ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues effectively.

✅ Ability to work with ticketing systems, live chat tools, and CRM platforms .

✅ Must be comfortable working with a camera on  for calls with customers and team members.

✅ Experience with B2B SaaS platforms  is a strong advantage.

Work Schedule

  • Full-time, remote .
  • Monday-Friday:  2 pm - 10 pm Ukrainian time, Sunday - half a day.
  • During the first month of training, work hours will be adjusted to align with the team for better learning and collaboration.

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote role  with a stable schedule .
  • Competitive salary  based on experience.
  • 12 PTO days, 10 sick days , and public holiday recognition.
  • Opportunity for professional growth  in a fast-growing SaaS company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Head de manutenção
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Head de manutenção para uma empresa localizada em Camaçari/BA .

Seu perfil corresponde ao da vaga descrita abaixo? Então, faça sua candidatura!


Objetivo da posição:

Coordenar a manutenção industrial, os projetos de CAPEX Sustaining, a confiabilidade, o planejamento e a gestão de custos, assegurando alta disponibilidade dos ativos, segurança operacional e uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, com forte controle de OPEX e CAPEX.


Principais responsabilidades:

Gestão de Equipe

  • Liderar equipes próprias e terceirizadas de: Mecânica; Elétrica; Instrumentação e Facilities
  • Desenvolver competências técnicas e comportamentais.
  • Garantir alocação eficiente de recursos e produtividade das equipes.
  • Assegurar práticas seguras, atendimento as normas e ambiente de trabalho adequado.
  • Promover o alinhamento e a comunicação assertiva com outros departamentos, garantindo que a Unidade de Negócio atinja seus objetivos globais de desempenho.


Gestão de Manutenção

  • Coordenar manutenções preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, garantindo confiabilidade e segurança dos ativos.
  • Assegurar resposta estruturada a falhas críticas e emergências.
  • Promover padronização técnica e disciplina operacional.
  • Realizar as rotinas de PCM (planejamento e programação);
  • Promover análises de falhas (RCA), FMEA e práticas de confiabilidade.
  • Reduzir falhas recorrentes, backlog e manutenções emergenciais.
  • Manter os indicadores de manutenção (KPIs) atualizados, assegurando o cumprimento das metas de desempenho e buscando a melhoria contínua dos processos.
  • Zelar pelo armazenamento técnico e organização de materiais no almoxarifado e pátios de equipamentos.


Gestão de Contratos e Facilities

  • Gerenciar contratos de manutenção industrial e facilities.
  • Controlar escopo, SLAs, custos, desempenho técnico e segurança dos prestadores.
  • Apoiar processos de contratação, renegociação e avaliação de fornecedores.
  • Buscar oportunidades de otimização de contratos e redução de custos totais.


Gestão de Custos (OPEX e CAPEX)

  • Gerir o orçamento anual de manutenção (OPEX) e de CAPEX Sustaining.
  • Elaborar previsões orçamentárias (budget e forecast).
  • Controlar custos de: Materiais e sobressalentes; Serviços e contratos
  • Analisar desvios entre planejado × realizado e definir planos de ação.
  • Implementar iniciativas de redução de custo sem aumento de risco operacional.
  • Garantir correta classificação contábil entre OPEX e CAPEX.
  • Projetos de Investimento – CAPEX Sustaining
  • Gerenciar o portfólio de CAPEX Sustaining.
  • Elaborar escopos técnicos, estimativas de investimento e cronogramas.
  • Acompanhar execução física e financeira dos projetos.
  • Garantir comissionamento, entrega técnica e incorporação correta dos ativos ao sistema de gestão.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida atuação em planejamento de manutenção industrial;
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos (CAPEX Sustaining);
  • Vivência em gestão de custos;
  • Domínio das ferramentas e metodologias de confiabilidade;
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (SAP PM);
  • Vivência em projetos de melhoria contínua e confiabilidade.


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with both technical systems and non-technical users .
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and clear way.
  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.

title: DevOps Engineer – Data Platforms (Kubernetes)
description:
Location: Remote (Americas preferred)

Type : Full Time Employment / Full Time Contractor

Department: Engineering – Platform & Database Operations

Company: Deep.BI


About Deep.BI

﻿Deep.BI provides consulting, enterprise support, and engineering services for open-source data infrastructure and real-time analytics platforms .

We help organizations design, deploy, migrate, and operate large-scale distributed data systems built on technologies such as:

  • Apache Druid
  • StarRocks
  • Apache Flink
  • Apache Kafka
  • Apache Cassandra
  • Kubernetes
  • Hadoop ecosystem

Our engineers work across the entire lifecycle of modern data platforms — from architecture and deployment to migrations, incident management, performance optimization, and custom feature development.


What you'll work on

You will help customers:

✔ Deploy Kubernetes-native data platforms

✔ Migrate from legacy or commercial systems to open-source stacks

✔ Operate high-availability distributed systems

✔ Build infrastructure supporting real-time analytics workloads


Key ResponsibilitiesPlatform Deployment
  • Deploy distributed data platforms including Kafka, Flink, Druid, StarRocks and Cassandra
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-native infrastructure
  • Implement high-availability and disaster recovery architectures
  • Configure autoscaling and resource optimization
  • Deploy systems across cloud, on-prem, hybrid, and BYOC environments
Platform Migrations
  • Execute commercial / enterprise → open-source migrations
  • Support legacy platform modernization
  • Implement zero-downtime migration 
  • Build or re-architect data ingestion pipelines and platform infrastructure
  • Ensure platform stability during large-scale migrations
Platform Operations
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems
  • Support mission-critical analytics platforms
  • Improve automation, deployment workflows, and reliability
  • Collaborate with engineering teams on platform architecture and operations


RequirementsCore Skills
  • Strong experience operating Kubernetes clusters in production
  • Kubernetes networking (e.g., Calico, Cilium)
  • Experience deploying large-scale distributed systems
  • Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and CI/CD
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex distributed infrastructure issues
  • Infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Helm, etc.)
  • Observability and monitoring systems


Experience With Data Platforms (Strongly Preferred)

Experience with one or more of the following:

  • Apache Kafka
  • Apache Flink
  • Apache Druid
  • StarRocks
  • Apache Cassandra
  • Hadoop ecosystem


Additional Skills (Nice to Have)
  • Experience operating large-scale data infrastructure
  • Experience supporting production environments with high availability requirements


Why Join Deep.BI
  • Work on cutting-edge open-source data technologies
  • Solve complex problems in distributed systems and data infrastructure
  • Collaborate with experts in streaming, database and platform engineering
  • Work in a fully remote engineering culture
  • Help organizations modernize their data platforms and analytics infrastructure
Interested? 

If you enjoy building and operating distributed infrastructure and modern data platforms, we would love to hear from you.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $6,500 - $7,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Lead Software Engineer who will collaborate with and shepherd software engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers, and will develop AI-based software solutions to better address the needs of their constituents (students, alumni, faculty, researchers, staff, and the community at large). You will have the chance to guide and continuously improve the ways in which they engage, educate, and empower people around the world, combining the best of human touch and technology scale, exploring the use of everything from the latest generative AI models to blended and immersive environments, multi-modal and varied-form content, and the most innovative research and teaching methodologies.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, taking into account business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives.
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology.
  • Design solutions, build initial code, and provide documentation with ways of working to minimize time to value and maximize re-usability.
  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what they do and how they do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value.
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert.
  • Actively contribute to and re-use community best practices.
  • Embody the values and passions that characterize the institution, with empathy to engage with colleagues from a wide range of backgrounds.
  • Promote software engineering, data science, machine learning, AI, and digital and emerging technologies within the institution through relevant channels including community engagement, networking, speeches, and publications as applicable.
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

Required skills

  • 7+ years of work experience in Software Engineering  or a Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics.
  • 3–5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment .
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products .
  • Strong Python  and Typescript/JavaScript  skills required.
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling  (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning  (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required.
  • Experience with cloud  computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform.
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required.
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities.


Desired skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable.
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews.
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas.
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

  • Análise e interpretação de dados.

title: Principal Project Manager Fast response Team
description:
T-Systems, a German multinational company belonging to the Deutsche Telekom Group, is looking for a highly experienced Principal Project Manager to join our Fast Response Team , supporting critical projects and services that require rapid stabilization and recovery.


This team plays a key role in safeguarding complex global projects, ensuring they return to the right track while rebuilding customer confidence.



Key responsibilities


• Plan and manage projects in a highly complex global IT environment

• Lead large interdisciplinary teams and subcontractors during project recovery and stabilization phases

• Implement quality gates, define corrective measures and monitor execution

• Conduct project reviews, identify weaknesses and drive improvement actions

• Define project structure, procedures and quality assurance measures

• Plan, schedule and control project phases, timelines and cost plans

• Manage project resources, including external partners, ensuring delivery on time, quality and budget

• Lead project status meetings and steering committees, reporting to senior leadership and top management

• Handle escalations, de-escalations and conflict management

• Apply best practices as part of the Zero Failure Program

• Establish cross-production control mechanisms to ensure implementation of quality measures

• Contribute to the evolution of project management and ITIL standards



Your profile


• At least 8+ years of experience in project or program management within IT environments

• Proven experience managing complex global IT projects with multiple international stakeholders

• Strong background in Data Center environments, cloud technologies and modern IT processes (AI, cloud, etc.)

• Solid experience in quality management, reporting and governance frameworks

• Deep understanding of IT service environments including application operations, infrastructure, networks and desktop services

• Strong knowledge of ITIL processes and service management practices

• Experience working in multicultural and international environments

• Outstanding skills in communication, negotiation, problem solving and decision-making

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills

• Highly proactive, structured and results-oriented mindset


Languages


• German – Business fluent

• English – Business fluent



If you are passionate about leading complex IT programs, solving critical project situations and working in an international environment, we would love to hear from you!

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles
